statement: A storage reservation can no longer expire out from under a live operation: the TTL-expiry sweep consults operation state the way the orphan-release arm already does (KEEP_ACTIVE for non-terminal operations), and capacity accounting stops treating expiresAt <= now as already-released before the sweep runs — no lease/renewal protocol. constraints.statement: Each new regression test must fail when the operation-state consult is reverted in either the TTL sweep or capacity accounting while the rest of the change remains.
Do not build a renewal/lease protocol in this Quest; mirror the orphan-release arm's KEEP_ACTIVE semantics for non-terminal operations only.
